decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the established offer and has had its own dedicated page in both years, a visible and continuing commitment, so management would hold on to it rather than write off the investment.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a publicly cited customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, so management would justify keeping it even though it has only a modest web presence and several sibling launches were already withdrawn.
